1.web: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
1.asv: A false balance is an abomination to Jehovah; But a just weight is his delight.

2.web: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
2.asv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.

3.web: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
3.asv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; But the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

4.web: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
4.asv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.

5.web: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
5.asv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way; But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

6.web: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
6.asv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them; But the treacherous shall be taken in their own iniquity.

7.web: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
7.asv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish; And the hope of iniquity perisheth.

8.web: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
8.asv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble; And the wicked cometh in his stead.

9.web: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
9.asv: With his mouth the godless man destroyeth his neighbor; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.

10.web: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
10.asv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

11.web: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
11.asv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

12.web: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
12.asv: He that despiseth his neighbor is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

13.web: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
13.asv: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.

14.web: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
14.asv: Where no wise guidance is, the people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

15.web: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
15.asv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth suretyship is secure.

16.web: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
16.asv: A gracious woman obtaineth honor; And violent men obtain riches.

17.web: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
17.asv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

18.web: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
18.asv: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness hath a sure reward.

19.web: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
19.asv: He that is stedfast in righteousness shall attain unto life; And he that pursueth evil doeth it to his own death.

20.web: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
20.asv: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to Jehovah; But such as are perfect in their way are his delight.

21.web: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the seed of the righteous will be delivered.
21.asv: Thoughhandjoinin hand, the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

22.web: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
22.asv: Asa ring of gold in a swine’s snout, So isa fair woman that is without discretion.

23.web: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
23.asv: The desire of the righteous is only good; Butthe expectation of the wicked is wrath.

24.web: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
24.asv: There is that scattereth, and increaseth yet more; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth only to want.

25.web: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
25.asv: The liberal soul shall be made fat; And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

26.web: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
26.asv: He that withholdeth grain, the people shall curse him; But blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

27.web: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
27.asv: He that diligently seeketh good seeketh favor; But he that searcheth after evil, it shall come unto him.

28.web: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
28.asv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; But the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

29.web: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
29.asv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind; And the foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

30.web: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
30.asv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; And he that is wise winneth souls.

31.web: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth; how much more the wicked and the sinner!
31.asv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth; How much more the wicked and the sinner!
